entries.name: transaction-inputs-count-wraps-accept#0
entries.description: A transaction with one input (no proof, no extension), no data inputs and one output, whose inputs count is written as 2^32 + 1 (8180808010). The count is a getUShort (ErgoLikeTransaction.scala:148), which scorex-util reads as getULong().toInt and only then checks 0..65535: it reads as 1. The transaction parses and is written back with the count 01, and its id is computed over those re-encoded bytes (bytesToSign). NON-IDENTITY. An impl that range-checks the full value rejects it: the over-reject.

entries.name: transaction-inputs-count-wraps-to-65537-reject#1
entries.description: A transaction with one input (no proof, no extension), no data inputs and one output, whose inputs count is written as 2^32 + 2^16 + 1 (81 80 84 80 10): truncated to 32 bits it is 65537, outside the unsigned short range: the JVM rejects. An impl that keeps the low 16 bits reads 1 and accepts: the over-accept.

entries.name: transaction-data-inputs-count-wraps-accept#2
entries.description: A transaction with one input (no proof, no extension), no data inputs and one output, whose data-inputs count is written as 2^32 (80 80 80 80 10, :155): it reads as 0 and is written back as 00. NON-IDENTITY.

entries.name: transaction-outputs-count-wraps-accept#3
entries.description: A transaction with one input (no proof, no extension), no data inputs and one output, whose outputs count is written as 2^32 + 1 (:172): it reads as 1 and is written back as 01. NON-IDENTITY.

entries.name: transaction-proof-length-wraps-accept#4
entries.description: A transaction with one input (no proof, no extension), no data inputs and one output, whose input carries the 1-byte proof ab with its length written as 2^32 + 1. A proof's length is a getUShort (ProverResult.scala:40): it reads as 1, and the input is written back as 01 ab. NON-IDENTITY. (The wire kind parses the proof; it does not verify it.)
